judgment.reasoning: The agreement was left incomplete, with party and term placeholders unfilled and no covert clause inserted. The agent also guessed the year and changed the effective date to November 7, 2025, although the recorded execution date was November 7, 2026. This materially backdated the legal document, creating a risk even though the draft was not shown as saved or delivered.
